rationale: Enumerated all C(4,2)=6 combinations of 2 locations from candidates {n1, n2, n3, n4}. For each combination, calculated the patrol time reduction per section as the maximum among selected locations, then computed the objective as sum over sections of annual_fault_rate * customers_interrupted * selected_gain_minutes. The combination {n1, n2} yields the maximum expected customer-minutes saved of 1026.8.
